description_en: Lists all exchanges in a specified vhost of an instance
description_zh: 查询指定实例下某一Vhost内创建的所有Exchange
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open list-exchanges --instance-id amqp-cn-7pp2mwbc0000 --virtual-host test --next-token AAAANDQBYW1xcC1jbi03cHAybXdiY3AwMGEBdmhvc3QBAXNkZndhYWJhATE2NDkzMTM4OTU5NDIB4o3z1pPwWzk4aYuiRffi8R6-0000 --max-results 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListExchanges

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for retrieving the next page of results. Set this parameter to the token value returned from the previous call.

Omit this parameter on your first call.

If a subsequent call is required, set this parameter to the `NextToken` value returned from the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
下一次查询的Token。取值：

如果是第一次查询或没有下一次查询，则无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，则取值为上一次返回的`NextToken`值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results
